TerminalBasis.description: Whether a terminal value is a value of the whole business or of its equity.

oneOf.description:
Enterprise value: flows to all capital providers (FCFF), discounted at the WACC;
multiples EV/EBITDA, EV/EBIT, EV/Sales.

Equity value: flows to shareholders (FCFE, dividends), discounted at the cost of
equity; multiple P/E.

basis.description:
`enterprise` (an operating income capitalised at a rate for all capital providers) or
`equity` (a net income capitalised at a cost of equity). Required, no default.

capitalisation_rate.description:
Capitalisation rate i, decimal fraction per period, greater than 0; must exceed
`growth`.

growth.description:
Perpetual growth of the income, decimal fraction per period, greater than -1 and below
the capitalisation rate. Default: none (R / i).

growth_cap.description:
Upper bound for the growth, decimal fraction per period. Default: none, reported as
absent. A growth above the cap is reported, not refused.

income.description: Normalised income R of the first period after the horizon, in currency units.
